_doc: Hollowed hound packs (ADR-0034). howl: the call one hound gives on first sight, which rallies its pack (all within pack_radius take up the chase) and is a sound the Hollowed hear. flank: a pack spreads round its quarry, each hound making for its own bearing round the player at radius m, spread degrees apart, before it closes in. retreat: after a bite a hound breaks off for this many seconds (min, max), then comes again. torch: a hound in front of a player holding a lit light keeps this far off and circles; one behind still bites. spawn: chance a wandering group is a pack instead (needs the hound's gamestage and the hollowed_hounds setting), and its multiplier at night; heat_pack: chance a heat 'pack' response at that gamestage is hounds.
